entities.summary: Pierre Boucher de Boucherville was a French settler, soldier, officer, naturalist, official, governor, and ennobled aristocrat in Nouvelle-France or New France. He is a direct ancestor of Pope Leo XIV. Pierre Boucher was a military leaders & commanders from Mortagne-au-Perche (1622-08-01, Mortagne-au-Perche–1717-04-19).
